title: The crow's peck and the seeder bot's scatter are far louder than the music behind them
tier_reason: Measured on the recording made for the Q-107 card: the story-night music sits near -30 dB RMS while the peck and the scatter peak at 0 dBFS, so they will clip on a tablet speaker and land far louder than the bed they sit in.
first_action: Play tools/record_story_sounds.sh's crow and robot segments and compare the cue peaks against the music; then trim peck_cc0_248254 and seeder_scatter_cc0_348953 (or their play_sfx gain) by about 6 dB.
ask: tools/record_story_sounds.sh records the three story-night moments with the game's own audio. On the crow night the music measures about -30 dB RMS and the two pecks peak at 0 dBFS (max_volume 0.0 dB); on the robot night the scatter does the same. Bring the one-shots down so they sit in the bed rather than over it — a trim on the files (keep the raws and note it in CREDITS.md) or a per-sound gain in AudioManager's table, whichever the table already supports — and re-record with the script to check. Do not change the picks; Q-107 is Daniel's.
source_message: Found by the chief of staff measuring the Q-107 recording, 2026-09-11.
result: The two wired recordings had already been trimmed by 6 dB in an earlier commit. I verified their original and wired peaks: crow peck -4.4 to -10.4 dBFS; seed scatter -3.3 to -9.3 dBFS. The originals named in CREDITS.md were missing from Git, so I restored both raw WAVs from the commit before the trim, with their Godot import files. I re-recorded all three Q-107 moments with tools/record_story_sounds.sh. The old combined video peaked at 0.0 dBFS and the new one peaks at -2.6 dBFS. A matched recording with each cue silenced isolates the peck at about -8.5 dBFS and scatter at about -6.7 dBFS; the backing audio in those windows is substantially lower. The robot segment still reaches -2.6 dBFS with scatter muted, so that overall peak is not the scatter. Daniel’s Q-107 picks and the AudioManager routing remain as ruled. Repository gateway, writing, HQ process (46/46), Godot unit, integration, robot session, benchmark and process-isolation gates passed locally; GitHub Actions passed for the landed audio commit.

diff.stat: Restored 2 raw WAVs and import files; refreshed Q-107 video and credits.

attempt_outcome.reason: Audio cue levels measured; missing raw sources restored; in-game recording refreshed; all gates passed.

check.summary: Verified audio source ratios and cue-isolated in-game captures; reviewed exact six-file diff and green repository gates.

landed.note: The 6 dB trims were already shipped; restored raw sources, refreshed the video, and measured both cues in game.
